stem.text: A battery with internal resistance is connected to a fixed resistor, an ammeter and a voltmeter, as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit with a dashed box around a battery and a resistor in series, an ammeter labelled A, a voltmeter labelled V and a second resistor.

stem.text: The battery is replaced by a different battery that has the same electromotive force (e.m.f.) but a greater internal resistance.
What happens to the readings on the ammeter and voltmeter?

D.text: stays the same; stays the same
